test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No Book is a Stone.

Some Stones are Soft.

**Conclusions:**

I. No Book is Soft.

II. Some Books are Soft.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
**Least Possible Venn Diagrm:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3335cb9d2a1f42fa810ccfc9668a4b2aa669d74e51e394d15881ba92df00c167.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No Book is Soft → **Doesn't Follows** (It can be possible but not definite because there is no direct relation between book and soft)

II. Some Books are Soft → Doesn't **Follows **(It can be possible but not definite because there is no direct relation between book and soft)

Hence, **neither (I) nor (II)** follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**** Complementary Pair:**

1) When subject and predicate are same in the conclusion.

2) Both the conclusion should be false possibly (but not definite).
